subject: Clarify invoice entity & tax forms for GCP Marketplace billing
messages:
From: Elena Morozova <elena.m@acme-analytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Finance <acme_finance@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: GCP marketplace invoice: entity mapping & W-8/W-9?

Hi Naomi,

Quick note as we're reconciling the September consumption invoice coming through GCP Marketplace for the pilot: Finance needs to know which Redwood legal entity will appear on the Marketplace invoice and whether you can provide a W-9 (US entity) or W-8BEN-E (non-US entity) for tax withholding purposes.

Questions we need answered before we process payment:
- Which legal entity will GCP show as the seller of record on our invoice?
- If it's a US entity, please send a completed W-9. If an international entity, we need a W-8BEN-E.
- If invoicing is routed via GCP (Marketplace-split billing) vs Redwood direct resale, does the invoice show Redwood or the cloud vendor?
- Any PO reference we should include to match your invoice to our purchase order (PO 12345).

We have a tight close window this week, so any docs you can share would be great.

Thanks,
Elena Morozova
Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morozova <elena.m@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace invoice: entity mapping & W-8/W-9?

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and the clear list. Short answers up front:
- Seller of record: For GCP Marketplace listings where Redwood is the listed partner, the invoice will show "Redwood Inference, Inc." (US entity) when the account is set as direct marketplace billing.
- Tax form: We'll attach a completed W-9 for the US entity. If you need the alternative (W-8BEN-E), we can provide that only if the marketplace transaction is routed through our non-US sub (rare).
- Invoice routing: For the current pilot, GCP is billing you directly (Marketplace line item) and GCP issues the invoice with Redwood as the partner line item; however payment obligations sit with Acme to GCP. That can complicate PO matching — see below.

Action items:
- I'm attaching our standard Redwood_W9.pdf for your team to file.
- Can you confirm whether Acme requires Redwood as a separate named line on your AP system or whether GCP's combined invoice is sufficient with PO 12345?

I'll loop in Karthik, our Billing Ops lead, to confirm the exact invoice reference strings you should match in your ERP.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: Redwood_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: GCP marketplace invoice: entity mapping & W-8/W-9?

Folks — forwarding Acme's note. They need: seller-of-record confirmation, W-9/W-8, and recommended PO matching fields for GCP Marketplace invoices. Key context:

- Pilot is currently billed through GCP Marketplace; Acme is asking whether Redwood appears as a discrete seller line (they prefer that for their AP).
- PO 12345 must be reflected on the invoice or Acme can't auto-apply the payment.

Karthik — can you confirm the exact invoice line text GCP uses for our listing and whether we can get GCP to include a PO reference? If not, can we issue a supplemental invoice to Acme (redwood direct) so they can match to PO 12345? That would be a resale model and likely requires a short contract tweak.

Ben — flagging in case sales needs to offer a temporary workaround (credit memo, manual matching) to avoid a payment hold.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morozova <elena.m@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Finance <acme_finance@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace invoice: entity mapping & W-8/W-9? (docs attached)

Hi Elena / Acme Finance team —

Thanks for your patience. Quick summary and attachments to get your AP team unstuck: 

1) Seller / invoice entity:
- For the current listing, GCP issues the invoice to Acme with a line item referencing "Redwood Inference, Inc." (our US legal entity). The seller-of-record on the GCP invoice is GCP, with Redwood identified as the partner line. That means your payment remits to GCP, not Redwood.

2) Tax forms and withholding:
- Because Redwood is identified as a US entity on the partner line, we are providing a W-9. Attached: Redwood_W9.pdf.
- If your AP requires a third-party payee invoice (Redwood direct), we can provide a Redwood-issued invoice instead, but that requires switching the procurement flow to Redwood as seller of record (resale). In that case, we would provide Redwood_W9 and an Acme-facing invoice referencing PO 12345.

3) PO matching guidance:
- GCP Marketplace invoices include a marketplace transaction ID in the invoice footer (example: MKT-987654). Please match either PO 12345 with the marketplace transaction ID. If your ERP doesn't support matching by transaction ID, let us know and we can request a supplemental Redwood invoice with PO 12345 on it.

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf; Acme_PO_12345.pdf

Next steps:
- If Acme is okay to pay GCP directly: accept the attached W-9 for tax records and confirm processing.
- If Acme needs Redwood direct invoicing: reply and we'll open a quick procurement change request (I can loop in Finance Ops).

Cc'ing Naomi for partnership context.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0167
